1.consolidated_definition: cosm. Cirugía facial para eliminar arrugas y otros defectos, generalmente los producidos por la vejez. Anglicismo crudo, frecuente. Iris, otra profesional que no quiso se le identificara con su apellido, decidió hacerse una cirugía facial (face lift) en 1997, cuando tenía 53 años (El Nuevo Día, 25-11-03)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Cosmética. Facial surgery to eliminate wrinkles and other defects, typically those caused by aging. Anglicism, often used. Iris, another professional who did not want to be identified with her surname, decided to undergo facial surgery (face lift) in 1997, when she was 53 years old.

2.consolidated_definition: Limpieza y reparación de la parte exterior de un edificio o estructura para modernizar su aspecto. Anglicismo crudo, frecuente. Otra ocasión para realizar la compra e instalación es antes del comienzo de la temporada de huracanes para proteger su residencia contra fuertes vientos y lluvias y antes de la época navideña para darle un face lift a la residencia (El Nuevo Día, 04-12-04)
2.en_consolidated_definition:
Exterior renovation or refurbishment of a building or structure to modernize its appearance.

Note: Anglicismo crudo translates to "raw anglicism" which refers to an unadapted English term used in Spanish language.

This process is often done before the start of hurricane season to protect one's residence from strong winds and rains, and also before the holiday season to give the residence a facelift.
